research_line: A retrospective reconstruction only; original B unchanged
Core: All 41970 completed eligible T0 person-months; no new selection or model calls
population: Each actual monthly materialized SCE frame; original positive survey weights only for integration; missing-weight rows retained with null weights
Normal: All non-Core source-frame persons, including 14 original date-excluded sampled persons; no individually dated LLM simulation claimed for them
entry_pools: newcomer / returner (including gap return) / unknown; no cross-pool borrowing
holdout: Only valid-Q9 existing LLM Core form the validation frame. Within entry/profile groups hold out at least one where n>=2, at most n-1; SHA ordering. Recalibrate remaining training weights to valid-Q9 Core group mass. Recalibrate heldout weights to the same full valid-Core mass of each evaluated group, correcting unequal fractions. Singleton groups remain unvalidated and coverage is reported. Test answers are LLM outputs, not human answers.
tau_selection: First minimize mean early48 monthly/seed heldout-LLM Q9 median absolute error; W1 tie-break; prefer smaller tau on ties to 1e-12. Do not select on current human targets or later months.
old_tau_rule: Earlier prototype chose tau24 using a different W1-first human-surrogate development rule. That choice is not treated as confirmed for T0.
estimation_weights: Original T0 analysis weights for conditional distributions; finite-population integration retains Core original raw weights and predicts only Normal/invalid Core field mass once
field_validity: Only actually updated model Q8/Q9 with finite frozen scores enter donor banks; input-retained and unfit Q9 never become donor answers
model_score_projection: A separate evaluation-side exporter validates logical fields against raw main/repair replies and input manifests, then exports frozen scores only for model-generated bin vectors. Prepare/predict never parse the mixed human/model score cache.
primary_summary: Exact posterior mean CDF integration; fixed-seed full roster draws are inspection-only, not the primary MAE/W1/IQR
evaluation: After prediction/selection sealed, read frozen full-wave truth and fixed public national targets. Before/after W1 and IQR must both use the same full-wave truth, not mix old same-roster W1 with expanded all-population W1. Refit MAE/MSE convex weights on early48, report later34 separately.
preservation: Original model replies, A/B evaluations, report v05 and package v02 remain unchanged. New ignored outputs and workstream only.
limits: Expansion is a statistical approximation and adds no independent LLM observations; late historical periods have been viewed and are not untouched blind tests. No promise of improved human fit.
